subject.title: fix(browser): use public ssrf runtime import in CDP proxy bypass

question: Should the Browser managed-proxy CDP bypass keep using owner-scoped private `ssrf-runtime-internal` access, or should `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` become part of the public `ssrf-runtime` SDK contract?
rationale: The current PR is source-incorrect, and the plausible alternative of adding the helper to `ssrf-runtime` would intentionally change the public SSRF/proxy bypass boundary.

options.title: Preserve Owner-Scoped Private Access
options.body: Keep the helper private to bundled Browser/Ollama paths and fix the package lazy-load path through resolver or staging coverage.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Promotion
options.body: Promote the helper only with explicit SDK/security approval, docs, export metadata, guardrails, and package smoke proof.

options.title: Choose A Canonical Sibling
options.body: Pause or close this branch if a sibling PR becomes the canonical repair for the same regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve Owner-Scoped Private Access
recommendation.body: Keep the helper private to bundled Browser/Ollama paths and fix the package lazy-load path through resolver or staging coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sits on the package/Plugin SDK boundary where steipete has both merger history and direct package-boundary commits.
